Acquisition: Tough: Increases Max Health by 3% and damage done by 3%.
column9: Bastian's Insight: Potions looted from monsters have a 30% chance to be improved by Bastian's Insight.

Acquisition: Dynamic: Increases damage done by 3% and healing done by 3%.
Companion Perk (and Keepsake effect): Mirri's Expertise: Treasure chests found through treasure maps and in the Overland have a 30% chance to provide additional loot from hidden compartments.

Acquisition: Cunning: Increases Critical Chance by 3% and damage done by 3%.
column9: Ember's Intuition: When pickpocketing, bestows a chance to acquire hidden wallets your mark hoped to keep secure. Hidden wallets may contain additional gold.

Acquisition: Enchanted: Decreases ability cooldowns by 3% and damage taken by 3%.
Companion Perk (and Keepsake effect): Isobel's Grace: Bestows a chance, after defeating a world boss, to recover the pack of a slain knight. Packs may contain additional loot.

Acquisition: Son of Kozanset: Increases Max Health by 3% and decreases ability cooldowns by 3%.
column9: Azandar's Inquisitiveness: When searching containers, it bestows a chance to discover research portfolios. Portfolios can contain crafting recipes, treasure maps, research notes, survey reports, and other documents of value.

Acquisition: Survivalist: Increases Physical and Spell Resistance by 3% and healing done by 3%.
Companion Perk (and Keepsake effect): Sharp's Patience: Fish bite at an increased rate and have a higher chance of being trophy fish. Note that this does not reduce your chance to hook special items.

Acquisition: Spirited: Decreases damage taken by 3% and increases damage done by 3%.
column9: Tanlorin's Finesse: When lockpicking, it bestows an increased time to pick a lock, an increased chance to force a lock, and a reduced chance to break a lockpick.

Acquisition: Third Moon's Chosen: Decreases ability cooldowns by 3% and increases Health by 3%.
Companion Perk (and Keepsake effect): Zerith's Guidance: Ja'kh uses his keen eyes to point out heavy sacks.
